Noah (Eng Manager): Quick one: our new hires start next week and I want a one-pager self-review + manager checklist to set expectations early. Short bullets only.
Renee (People Ops): Nice idea. Heres a compact "onboarding review" template you can share at week 4 and week 12. Paste into 1:1 agendas.
Renee (People Ops): ```Week 4 (5 min) - IC self-check
- Role fit: one line on what youre owning and confidence level (low/med/high).
- Quick win: one small deliverable or learning this month.
- Blockers: one ask for manager help.

Week 12 (10 min) - IC self-review
- Impact summary: top contribution and result (1 line).
- Skills growth: one skill you improved and evidence.
- Career direction: short note on next steps you want (stretch project, mentoring).
```
Noah (Eng Manager): Love that. Can we also get a 3-line manager checklist for those checkpoints?
Renee (People Ops): Sure. ```Manager checklist (copy/paste)
- Week 4: confirm role clarity, remove 1 blocker, set 1 short learning objective.
- Week 12: review impact vs expectations, provide 1 growth recommendation, discuss career direction and capture in notes.
- Calibration: if concerns, flag to People Ops with examples.```
Kai (Hiring Ops): Heads-up: for new hires on ramping plans, include "mentorship pairing" as a suggested action at Week 12. Helps retention.
Marta (Dir, People): Add a tiny rating snippet managers can copy: "On track / Needs support" and a 1-line rationale. If "Needs support" include a specific next step and owner.
Noah (Eng Manager): Perfect. Ill paste into the welcome packet and ping new hires to fill the week-4 self-check in advance of 1:1.
hr-bot: Reminder: onboarding resources are at https://intranet.redwood/onboarding  Please link the week-12 note to the employee profile.
Renee (People Ops): If any managers want a Google Doc with prefilled headings, DM and Ill share a template. :sparkles:
